tickets.title: Model HELOC payment impact scenarios
tickets.text: Model the HELOC payment impact for Julian Mossbutton, using the Teacup Comet Bank line balance of $74,500 and the reset payment of $925, both as a standalone amortizing loan and as part of a broader mortgage refinance structure.
tickets.evidence: Julian wanted the payment impact modeled with and without rolling the line into a broader refinance structure.

tickets.title: Prepare updated cash‑flow budget
tickets.text: Prepare an updated cash‑flow budget for Julian and Lena Mossbutton, reflecting the reduced household take‑home pay of $9,250 per month, core spending of $7,850, and existing debt obligations, to establish a target for accelerated debt repayment.
tickets.evidence: the revised budget is needed before setting a target for accelerated debt repayment.

tickets.title: Estimate tax consequences of investment liquidation
tickets.text: Estimate the tax consequences for Julian Mossbutton of liquidating appreciated holdings in his joint taxable investment account at Velvet Acorn Custody, valued at approximately $96,000, to fund debt reduction.
tickets.evidence: the tax impact needs to be estimated before using investments as a funding source.
